children: Shanghai Enflame Technology, the last of China's "four little GPU Tigers," made a strong trading debut in Shanghai, capping off a wave of listings of the country's prominent AI chip startups.

The Shanghai-based chip designer's shares surged 202% to 430.00 yuan from its initial public offering price of 142.18 yuan on Friday, implying a market capitalization of 185.05 billion yuan, equivalent to $27.59 billion.
Drawing the same level of enthusiasm as its peers, Enflame raised 6.12 billion yuan in gross proceeds in its offering.
Enflame follows Moore Threads and MetaX Integrated Circuits, which listed in Shanghai late last year, and Shanghai Biren Technology, which debuted in Hong Kong in early 2026.

Dubbed the "four little GPU tigers" due to their leadership in building graphics processing units, the chip makers represent part of China's push to end reliance on foreign technology and nurture a "homegrown Nvidia."

title: Final China "GPU Tiger" Soars in Trading Debut
